atlassian.note: Jira + Confluence + Bitbucket. OAuth 2.1. Least privilege — review high-impact writes. SSE endpoint /sse deprecated mid-2026; use /mcp.

aws-core.note: AWS API access. IAM scoped read-biased by default. Promote to write only inside an approved change.

aws-terraform.note: Terraform plan/apply via MCP. Read-only by default. Write = explicit DevOps approval.

aws-eks.note: EKS cluster + workload operations. Scoped to read + describe by default.

aws-cost.note: Pre-deploy cost estimates + cost analysis. Read-only.

neo4j.note: Neo4j graph (read-only by default). Set NEO4J_READ_ONLY=false only inside an approved migration with a rollback plan.

github.note: PR/CI access for Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA agents. Merge permission denied at agent tool level.
